text: Scrape a page with a single API call using just an API key and target URL
quote: To scrape a web page, you only need two things: Your API key... The encoded web page URL you want to scrape

text: Renders JavaScript-heavy SPAs built with React, Angular, jQuery, or Vue
quote: This can be useful for scraping a Single Page Application built with frameworks such as React.js, Angular.js, JQuery or Vue.

text: Supports scripted page interactions (JS scenario) like clicking and filling before returning HTML
quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.

text: Waits for a specified CSS/XPath selector to appear before returning rendered HTML
quote: Our headless browsers will wait for the CSS / Xpath selector passed in the parameter before returning the HTML.

text: Can block ads on the target page to speed up scraping requests
quote: By default, ScrapingBee does not block ads. To avoid scraping them (e.g.,to speed up your request), use `block_ads=true`

text: Blocks images and CSS by default to reduce bandwidth and speed up requests
quote: By default, and to speed up requests, ScrapingBee blocks all images and CSS in the scraped page, but to scrape them, use `block_resources=false`

text: Lets you set custom browser viewport width and height when rendering
quote: If you need to change the dimension of the browser's viewport (window) when scraping the target page you can use the `window_width` and `window_height` parameters.

text: Extracts specific fields from a page using CSS selector-based extraction rules
quote: extract_rules [stringified JSON] ("") Data extraction from CSS selectors

text: Uses AI (ai_query) to extract information from a page via natural-language instructions
quote: ai_query [string] ("") The information you want to extract from the webpage using AI

text: Offers premium proxies to bypass hard-to-scrape sites
quote: premium_proxy [boolean] (false) Use premium proxies to bypass difficult to scrape websites

text: Lets you choose a proxy's country for geolocation-specific content
quote: country_code [string] ("") Premium proxy geolocation

text: Supports session IDs to route multiple requests through the same IP
quote: session_id [integer] ("") Route multiple API requests through the same IP address

text: Can capture a screenshot of a specific page area via a CSS selector, or the whole page
quote: screenshot_selector [string] ("") Return a screenshot of a particular area of the page, targeted by a CSS selector

text: Has an 'auto' mode that automatically picks the cheapest configuration that still succeeds
quote: mode [string] ("") Let ScrapingBee pick the cheapest configuration that succeeds. Only value is auto

text: Can return page content in Markdown format instead of raw HTML
quote: return_page_markdown [boolean] (false) Return the page content in markdown format

text: By default fetches pages through a headless browser that executes page JavaScript
quote: By default, ScrapingBee fetches the URL to scrape via a headless browser that will execute the JavaScript code on the page.

text: Can output plain text as well as markdown, giving a choice of LLM-ready formats
quote: Any page to clean Markdown or plain text, LLM-ready.

text: Uses a special stealth proxy pool to avoid detection
quote: Use special stealth proxy pool

text: Provides a no-code connector to drop scraping into Make automation workflows
quote: Drop ScrapingBee into any make workflow, no code.

text: Provides a managed rotating proxy pool so users don't need to build their own proxy fleet
quote: keep scraping without building your own proxy fleet.

text: Offers dedicated scraping for Amazon product, pricing, and review data
quote: Collect Amazon product, pricing, and review data directly for monitoring, analytics, and competitive research.

text: Gives AI agents direct access to web scraping capability
quote: Give your AI agent direct access to web scraping.
